_README: Human-versus-animal resolution for rows whose species field is NOT_APPLICABLE (purified-protein or unspecified assay systems). Produced by reading each source's Materials and Methods and quoting the sentence that names the species of origin. Applied by build_dataset.py. Source-level entries apply to every unresolved row of that source; row_overrides are matched on (source_id, system_model) for sources whose assays differ. A source that never states the origin is recorded as not_stated and its rows stay species_class = not_determined -- the field-customary inference (a commercial purified protein is 'probably human') is deliberately NOT made.

resolutions.basis_quote: Human coagulation factors II, VII, IX and X were isolated from fresh frozen plasma using the methods of Bajaj et al. and Jenny et al.
resolutions.note: All assays in this source, including the synthetic coagulation proteome, are built from human factors.

resolutions.basis_quote: Human alpha thrombin, human factor Xa, and human fibrinogen were purchased from Haematologic Technologies Inc.
BALB/c mice were injected with 5 mg/kg, 10 mg/kg, 25 mg/kg, or 50 mg/kg of ISIS 410944, ISIS 410973, ISIS 410974, or ISIS 410975, administered subcutaneously twice a week for 3 weeks.
resolutions.note: Every worked example in the patent is rodent; no human system appears anywhere in it.

resolutions.basis_quote: On day 1, two cynomolgus macaque (Macaca fascicularis) primates (both male, 5.0 kg and 8.15 kg, respectively) were co-injected with 2 mg/kg RNAi trigger (AD01001) and 2 mg/kg MLP delivery polymer.

row_overrides.system_model: fluorogenic peptidyl substrate cleavage by clot-bound versus free thrombin
row_overrides.basis_quote: Plasma clots were prepared in a 96-well plate by adding 20 uL of citrated pooled human plasma (George King Bio-Medical) to 20 uL of 25 mm CaCl2 solution.
row_overrides.note: The thrombin measured is endogenous thrombin trapped in a clot formed from human plasma, the clot having been washed to remove free thrombin. The comparator arm uses a purified thrombin whose species the paper never states.

row_overrides.basis_quote: Prolongation of APTT was also achieved by addition of ISIS 2302 to citrated blood from untreated monkeys, allowing the investigation of the mechanism of inhibition in vitro.
row_overrides.note: The species attaches through the text's own chain (monkey blood -> 'allowing the investigation of the mechanism' -> 'Additional in vitro studies'), but the mechanism sentence does not itself repeat the species; hence medium.

not_stated.note: 'human' modifies 'plasma' in the one candidate sentence, not the purified thrombin-time components.
The only species-bearing sentence attaches to the aPTT-in-plasma framing statement, not to the 8 purified/reconstituted assays.
Rows are reporting-silence records drawn from prophetic boilerplate; no assay, no species.
Row is anchored to a definitions-section list of candidate assessment variables; names no system.
US 7,538,211 Example 6B names no species, subject, route or group size.
Ki values are a Discussion recollection of work done elsewhere; this paper ran no purified-thrombin experiment.
The pegaptanib aPTT claim is cited from elsewhere; no pegaptanib experiment exists in this paper.

Five purified-protein rows: 'Thrombin, fibrinogen, and the thrombin fluorogenic substrate were obtained from Prolytix' -- no species, no catalogue numbers. Not upgraded to human on the strength of a supplier's catalogue being predominantly human.
Two purified-enzyme rows: neither the enzymes nor the substrates are given a species anywhere in the document.
